Existing T09 reviewed change is sound; this separate repair closes reproduced base-and-candidate frozen-world gap. Scope adds correctness, no approved capability removed. Specs/YAML/reports may read. No stage/commit/push, delegation, frozen-plan or rootledger edits.

Dependencies T09. No dependent release until exact joint full gate plus owner/static/review. This task precedes T15 and T18e; no prior AE writer. Owner source ruling already in AE comments must be preserved: INTERACT intent trigger and _update_affordance_tracking timing are separate from actual dones-filtered interaction mask. Do not casually remove or consolidate that intent/active distinction. Existing VTC progress contracts remain.

Confirmed actual authored trigger: both worlds GET then WAIT, world0 becomes terminal via authored lifecycle while world1 lives. Nextstep [DROP_SLOT_0,WAIT] mutates world0 inventory [0]->[-1] despite entryactiveFalse. Astra reproduced candidate and exact base ENV; neither input state nor masks/dones/inventory were manually injected. WAIT dead-row control passes. No claim that live selector emitted this action. API must treat dead action slots as transport and ignore physical intent. AE currently moves substrate rows and handles GET/USE/DROP/custom-item rows without activity gating; INTERACT has an existing separate active debit mask. Treat entry eligibility, not after-step terminals: live terminal-causing action still executes once, and live siblings remain correct.

Requirements:
1. New meaningful authored regression (use actual pack/items and supported env API from counted existing T09 test) reproduces terminal DROP changing inventory, with real live sibling progression and frozen completed-row observation/item/position/meter witnesses. Demonstrate intended assertion red; no setup/import false red.
2. Correct AE physical execution admission for completed rows across movement, GET/USE/DROP and custom item branches where authored support exists. Never turn a genuinely live illegal input into an inactive lane or invent a legalaction. Preserve working live actions, including terminal-causing actions. Keep actual action vector available to VTC with its existing explicit active mask; no new public signature/default needed. Respect separate existing INTERACT-intent timing comment.

Capture canonical successor masks and once-only completion unchanged. Do not claim complete simulator-state proof beyond inspected owner interfaces; future PW12 still inventories allstate.

Direct installed /workspace/hamlet/.venv/bin/python; OMP/MKL1 torch1 root/import/hashbeforeafter. Use .superpowers/... reports but no external executable helper source. Freeze owned AE/newtest after scoped Ruff/Black/mypy and whole no-defaults614 (no ratchet/whitelist change).
5. Report task-T09a-report.md: actual wholefile inventory, sourcehashes, exact red/assertions/green/ownercommands, named effects/limits, preserved old interaction trigger evidence, no wholeBACgreen. Independent other-model adversarial review then root fixedsumtree collection/owner/sixguards/full suite required.

No oracle edits, variable-name branching, hidden defaults, local installs/new access/spending/deployment. One coordinator owns integration and index.
